answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) acquire extensive world knowledge through pretraining on massive text corpora. This knowledge is subsequently shaped through post-training techniques such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning, enabling LLMs to perform diverse downstream tasks, including reading comprehension (Samuel et al., 2024), code generation (Rozière, and tool use.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates answers to factual questions in a closed-book setting, such as 'The capital of Bon Homme County is ____'.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics include accuracy, categorized by different knowledge mastery levels, with the mean accuracy across all test sets serving as the final metric
